map.选择物探方法，输入装置参数估算探测深度与垂直分辨率: Choose a geophysical method and enter the array parameters to estimate the depth of investigation and vertical resolution.
map.💡 电法：探测深度 ≈ AB/2；垂直分辨率 ≈ 电极距 a（Wenner）。: 💡 Electrical: depth of investigation ≈ AB/2; vertical resolution ≈ electrode spacing a (Wenner).
map.探测深度为经验估算，受地电/磁性条件影响: The depth of investigation is an empirical estimate, affected by geoelectric/magnetic conditions
map.电法探测深度随极距增大而加深: The electrical depth of investigation deepens as the electrode spread increases
map.磁法深度估算用 Peters 半宽法: Magnetic depth estimation uses the Peters half-width method
map.📚 深度解析：地球物理勘探应用参数估算（探测深度/分辨率）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Estimating Applied Parameters in Geophysical Exploration (Depth of Investigation / Resolution)
map.电法装置设计：由供电极距 AB 估探测深度与垂直分辨率: Electrical array design: estimate the depth of investigation and vertical resolution from the current electrode spread AB
map.磁法反演：由异常半宽按 Peters 法估磁性体埋深: Magnetic inversion: estimate the burial depth of the magnetic body from the anomaly half-width by the Peters method
map.地震分辨率：由波速、主频、走时估反射深度与垂向分辨率: Seismic resolution: estimate the reflection depth and vertical resolution from velocity, dominant frequency and travel time
map.算法（三法可选）：电法探测深度≈AB/2、垂直分辨率≈电极距 a、深径比=深度/: Algorithm (three methods optional): electrical depth of investigation ≈ AB/2, vertical resolution ≈ electrode spacing a, depth-to-spacing ratio = depth/a; magnetic (Peters method) depth h ≈ anomaly half-width hw/1.31, resolution ≈ h/4, anomaly full width = 2·hw; seismic reflection depth H=v·t/2, wavelength λ=v/f, vertical resolution ≈ λ/4. Used to assess scheme feasibility and survey-line layout.
map.例（电法）：AB=200m、a=20m → 探测深度≈100.00m、分辨率≈2: Example (electrical): AB=200 m, a=20 m → depth of investigation ≈100.00 m, resolution ≈20.00 m, depth-to-spacing ratio=5.00 (a larger ratio helps resolve deep thin layers). Example (magnetic): anomaly half-width hw=40 m → depth h≈40/1.31=30.53 m, resolution ≈7.63 m, anomaly full width 80.00 m, indicating a shallow magnetic source.
map.探测深度和分辨率能同时提高吗？: Can the depth of investigation and resolution be improved at the same time?
map.通常相互制约：加大极距/偏移距增深但分辨率下降。电法深径比（深度/分辨率）是折中: They usually trade off: increasing the electrode spacing/offset deepens but lowers the resolution. The electrical depth-to-spacing ratio (depth/resolution) is a compromise indicator; design should derive the required spacing from the target size rather than simply seeking depth.
map.Peters 法假设板状磁性体且异常近似对称，对简单孤立磁源较适用；倾斜产状或叠: The Peters method assumes a slab-like magnetic body with a nearly symmetric anomaly and suits simple isolated magnetic sources; a dipping attitude or overlapping anomalies distort the half-width, so the result should be used with the section shape and inversion as a preliminary estimate.
map.面向工程物探的应用参数估算工具，按电法、磁法、地震反射三种方法，输入装置参数估算: An applied-parameter estimation tool for engineering geophysics: for electrical, magnetic and seismic reflection methods, enter the array parameters to estimate the depth of investigation and vertical resolution, providing a reference for geophysical scheme design and result interpretation.
map.三种方法探测深度与分辨率估算: Depth-of-investigation and resolution estimation for three methods
map.电法含深径比评价: Electrical method includes a depth-to-spacing ratio assessment
map.地震采用 Widess λ/4 准则: Seismic uses the Widess λ/4 criterion
